Island farmers market returns to Hagåtña

September 25, 2026

The weekly farmers market at the Chamorro Village returned Wednesday evening after a two-month break for repairs, drawing hundreds of shoppers looking for fresh produce, local desserts and barbecue.

Vendors said sales were strong despite the rain, and organizers plan to add a second market night in October.

The market is open every Wednesday from 5 to 9 p.m.
